column8: Not a push-up, and not counted. On the video you stand up and walk towards the phone at the end of the set; the app was still counting and today refused it with "Keep your legs in the picture". Nothing in the counter changed: no reading I tried (torso angle, view) separates such moments from a real rep reliably yet, so they stay refused with words meant for a rep. The clip now runs 1:53.2–1:55.3 (it used to start at 1:54.2). "other" is the label for a moment that is not a push-up.
